# Normalization layers

LayerNorm/RMSNorm variants, including SandwichNorm (required for stable recurrent-depth bias). Each transformer sublayer (attention, feedforward) has two norm positions: pre, on its input, and post, on its output before it joins the residual. An entry decides which positions are filled and with what. There is no final norm before the head.

Namespace: ``registry.namespace("normalization")``, declared in ``praxis.normalization`` (8 entries)

Selected with ``--norm-type`` (default: ``rms_norm``).

## `hero` - HeroNorm

Both positions, mixed types: LayerNorm at pre, RMSNorm at post. Centering conditions
what the sublayer reads, while the write back to the residual is rescaled without having
its mean stripped, so the branch keeps the freedom to move the stream's mean.

Source: [praxis/normalization/sandwich_norm.py:70](../praxis/normalization/sandwich_norm.py#L70)

## `hero_inverted` - InvertedHeroNorm

Both positions, hero's mirror image: RMSNorm at pre, LayerNorm at post.

Source: [praxis/normalization/sandwich_norm.py:82](../praxis/normalization/sandwich_norm.py#L82)

## `layer_norm` - LayerNorm

LayerNorm at the pre position only.

Source: [praxis/normalization/layer_norm.py:11](../praxis/normalization/layer_norm.py#L11)

## `none` - BaseNorm

No normalization at either position.

Source: [praxis/normalization/base.py:10](../praxis/normalization/base.py#L10)

## `post_rms_norm` - PostRMSNorm

RMSNorm at the post position only.

Source: [praxis/normalization/rms_norm.py:52](../praxis/normalization/rms_norm.py#L52)

## `rms_norm` - RMSNorm

RMSNorm at the pre position only.

Source: [praxis/normalization/rms_norm.py:11](../praxis/normalization/rms_norm.py#L11)

## `sandwich` - SandwichNorm

RMSNorm at both positions, with a separate weight for each.

Source: [praxis/normalization/sandwich_norm.py:47](../praxis/normalization/sandwich_norm.py#L47)

## `sandwich_tied` - TiedSandwichNorm

RMSNorm at both positions, sharing a single weight between them.

Source: [praxis/normalization/sandwich_norm.py:51](../praxis/normalization/sandwich_norm.py#L51)
